reviewer: Codex model reinspection; same reviewer as original; no independent educator rater

excluded_sets.ela: No ELA text, reading, writing, or language standard is an intended score construct.
excluded_sets.science: No science instruction or NGSS alignment is claimed.
excluded_sets.humanities: No historical or humanities source interpretation is assigned.
excluded_sets.rehearsal: No teacher rehearsal, role-play, or simulated teacher dialogue is included; possible response patterns are diagnostic hypotheses, not a rehearsal.

ratings.title: Target and evidence agree
ratings.pass_when: The task elicits the stated learning target and claimed standard; any alignment limit is explicit.
ratings.locator: corrected-resource.md:S1 items 1–3; T1 Target; T7 Alignment
ratings.reason: Students find both measures and explain what each counts. The teacher notes identify only partial standards coverage and explicitly exclude a full 3.MD.7.a or mastery claim.

ratings.title: Content and keys are accurate
ratings.pass_when: Worked examples, accepted answers, units and scoring directions are correct and internally consistent.
ratings.locator: corrected-resource.md:T2 key; T3 profile; T5 model/recheck; T6 extension
ratings.reason: Independently recomputed 3×5=15 and 2(3+5)=16; 3×4=12 and 2(3+4)=14; 2×5=10 and 2(2+5)=14; 2×6=12 and 2(2+6)=16. Keys and units are consistent. T3 uses expected values rather than carrying initial-ticket values into the recheck.

ratings.title: Claims and sources are represented honestly
ratings.pass_when: External claims have supporting opened sources; authored tasks and uncertain observations are labeled.
ratings.locator: corrected-resource.md:opening Status; T2 authored-example note; T4 hypothesis note; T5 research limits; T7 sources
ratings.reason: Authored tasks, timings, examples, and diagnostic hypotheses are labeled. Sources were opened and checked; WWC recommendation ratings are preserved without claiming validation of this ticket.

ratings.title: Materials are usable
ratings.pass_when: The promised student tasks, source stimuli, teacher directions and timing are present and feasible.
ratings.locator: corrected-resource.md:T1 administration; S1 student section; T2 key; T3 record; T4–T6 teaching/recheck
ratings.reason: Student tasks, materials, response space, estimated timing, accessible modes, keys, follow-up actions, and another task are present. The teacher is instructed to distribute only S1; teacher keys remain in teacher sections.

ratings.title: Evidence supports the inference
ratings.pass_when: Individual learning, group products, behavior, simulation and missing evidence are distinguished; score claims stay within the data.
ratings.locator: corrected-resource.md:T3 evidence codes and denominator identities; T4 last paragraph; T7 limits
ratings.reason: Individual profiles, prompted performance, no evidence, absence, and class patterns are separated. The profile does not infer durable mastery, diagnosis, or readiness from a choice or group percentage.

ratings.title: Participation and support are appropriate
ratings.pass_when: Required supports, privacy and developmentally appropriate directions are preserved; no unjustified exclusion or harmful labeling.
ratings.locator: corrected-resource.md:T1 Access; T3 private rows; T4 last paragraph
ratings.reason: Required supports continue; the learner may express the same mathematics in several ways. The resource avoids labels and automatic placement and makes records private. Pass is for written design, not a claim that unseen student plans were implemented.

ratings.title: Mathematical meaning
ratings.pass_when: Representations, symbols and operations agree; explanation matches the mathematical construct.
ratings.reason: Area is linked to unit-square coverage and perimeter to the length of the outside boundary. Operations and units agree throughout; the model explicitly excludes internal edges from perimeter.

ratings.title: Student reasoning
ratings.pass_when: Tasks require the reasoning warranted by the target and accept defensible strategies.
ratings.locator: corrected-resource.md:S1 item 3; T2 accepted reasoning; T3 distinction row; T6 extension
ratings.reason: Students must explain/model what the measures count. Correct counting, repeated addition, multiplication, drawings, gestures, and oral reasoning are accepted. Formula-only work is not overinterpreted as conceptual distinction.

ratings.title: Construct-preserving access
ratings.pass_when: Supports address a stated barrier and preserve required accommodations; changed constructs are disclosed.
ratings.locator: corrected-resource.md:T1 Access; T3 AP and support notes
ratings.reason: Reading, handwriting, language, and communication barriers have defined options. Required supports remain. Assistance supplying a target component is disclosed and successful prompted performance is P-AP, while access support alone does not lower the math judgment.

ratings.title: Usable language support
ratings.pass_when: Language objectives and actual models/frames fit the content; fading applies to optional prompts, not required access.
ratings.locator: corrected-resource.md:T1 Optional language support; T5 model/frame
ratings.reason: The frame serves the stated explanation purpose and leaves mathematics for the learner. The model fits the content. Only the optional frame may fade when appropriate; required access continues. This criterion becomes applicable because a language scaffold is now included.

ratings.title: Diagnostic interpretation
ratings.pass_when: Distractors and response patterns support tentative hypotheses; missing/ambiguous responses receive follow-up rather than unsupported labels.
ratings.locator: corrected-resource.md:T4 response-pattern table; T3 clarification/AP notes
ratings.reason: Distractor interpretations are explicitly tentative and use a neutral probe before teaching. Correct-choice/weak-reasoning, units, blank, ambiguous, and conflicting responses receive distinct follow-up.

ratings.title: Actionable follow-up
ratings.pass_when: The packet supplies a next teaching move and another task keyed to the observed evidence.
ratings.locator: corrected-resource.md:T4 table; T5 brief model, fresh recheck, decision; T6 extension
ratings.reason: The resource connects observed strategies to an immediate teaching move, supplies a new 2-by-5 task and key, and uses new evidence to decide next instruction.

ratings.title: Need and intensity
ratings.pass_when: Activities match a documented target gap; tier, placement and cause are not inferred from a single score.
ratings.reason: Support follows an observed and checked target gap; tier, disability, and cause are not inferred from one response. The short activity is bounded classroom reteaching, with existing supports and the established problem-solving process retained.

ratings.title: Implementation and monitoring
ratings.pass_when: The adult has models, keys, bounded scaffold decisions and feasible checks/regrouping rules.
ratings.locator: corrected-resource.md:T5 full model, prompt boundary, recheck/key, decision; T1 optional frame
ratings.reason: The adult has a concrete model, correct key, timing estimate, scaffold guidance, and a feasible recheck and next-step rule. No outcome is claimed without student evidence.

ratings.title: Policy and arithmetic
ratings.pass_when: Calculation uses the declared policy, correctly handles missing/exempt evidence and can be reproduced.
ratings.locator: corrected-resource.md:T3 categories, P-AP instruction, class summary and count equations
ratings.reason: The declared policy is formative categories without a total grade. D/P/N/NE are mutually exclusive for each offered student's row; P-AP is included within P and tagged separately. Blank offered papers stay NE, and absent/not-offered students remain separate visible counts. No numerical class data are invented.

ratings.title: Defensible interpretation
ratings.pass_when: Rollups retain coverage/support conditions; ordinal scales, growth and uncertainty are not misrepresented.
ratings.locator: corrected-resource.md:T3 reporting rate/support notes; T4 final paragraph; T7 limits
ratings.reason: Any rate uses the named offered denominator and exposes missingness and prompts. Categorical profiles are not averaged or turned into mastery, disability, or placement. Broader claims require additional evidence.

limit: Summarizes supplied reviewer judgments only; no claim of classroom efficacy, psychometric validity or independent automated pedagogical evaluation.
